verdict.rationale: Jitsu routes events to warehouses (ClickHouse, BigQuery, Snowflake, Redshift, Postgres, S3, GCS) and "dozens of SaaS tools". It has a documented destinations catalog, a generic webhook destination, and Functions that filter, transform and enrich events before they reach a destination. Routing can be controlled by choosing which sources connect to which destinations. Missing for 10: explicit documentation that mapping and filters bind per destination or connection, evidence the catalog is "large" (the only stated size is "dozens" of SaaS tools), and independent hands-on corroboration of the destination breadth.
